Processing Capabilities Register

Platform Capabilities

Six institutional-grade capabilities defining our technical edge across RF intelligence, autonomous systems, and collective AI.

01 —Radar Emitter Location EstimationRF/GEOPrecision geolocation using multi-sensor fusion and TDOA algorithms. Combines angle-of-arrival with power-differential estimation and extended Kalman filtering to achieve sub-10m CEP at operational ranges.
02 —Radar Signal Processing & DeinterleavingDSPReal-time pulse deinterleaving separating overlapping pulse trains from multiple emitters with sub-2ms latency. Handles dense signal environments with up to 40+ simultaneous sources using custom PDW analysis.
03 —ML-Based Radar Signal ClassificationAI/RFDeep CNNs for automated waveform identification achieving >97% classification accuracy across 40+ radar archetypes. Operates in real-time on edge hardware via quantised ONNX inference — no cloud dependency.
04 —Federated Learning for Signal AnalysisFL/MLPrivacy-preserving distributed ML enabling collaborative model training across dispersed sensor nodes without centralising raw signal data. Supports heterogeneous node capabilities with gradient compression.
05 —Heterogeneous UAV Swarm SystemSWARMMulti-domain swarm coordination managing platforms with differing performance envelopes using adaptive formation control. Decentralised decision-making via MARL policies with encrypted BLE mesh coordination.
06 —Enfibio AI Swarm IntelligenceAI/BIOProprietary collective intelligence applying bio-inspired optimisation — stigmergy, quorum sensing, and emergent task allocation — to enable robust autonomous coordination without central orchestration.
